fields.description: Issue features prominent coverage of South Florida oil development at the Sunniland field, including photographs and discussion of production constraints and related political controversy. Also includes investigative and editorial reporting on Miami and Miami Beach politics, allegations involving a Miami police officer (Lt. C. O. Huttoe) and police corruption, and discussion of legal and political implications connected to the Esther Jacobson–Joseph F. Jacobson divorce case and a judicial election. Additional local columns address municipal court cases, juvenile theft arrests, consumer/real-estate fraud concerns, and community notices and advertisements.
